introduction: Work First New Jersey provides temporary cash and related support. Apply through MyNJHelps or your County Social Service Agency, then complete the interview and verification.
description: Work First New Jersey provides temporary cash and related support. Apply through MyNJHelps or your County Social Service Agency, then complete the interview and verification.

sections.who: TANF serves qualifying families with children; General Assistance serves qualifying adults or couples without children. Income, resources, residence and status requirements apply, alongside case-specific work and child-support obligations.
sections.get: Approved cases receive monthly cash assistance and may receive employment, transportation or childcare support. The worker explains which category and obligations apply.
sections.docs:
• Identity and requested status records.
  • Current income and resource evidence.
  • Residence information unless experiencing homelessness.
  • Children’s and caregiver details where relevant.
sections.apply:
1. Submit the request

    Use MyNJHelps or send the state paper application to your county agency.

  2. Complete the interview

    Follow the phone or in-person appointment instructions. Describe an immediate lack of shelter, food or essential utilities.

  3. Provide missing proof

    Upload through MyNJHelps or follow the county’s instructions; apply even if some records are initially missing.
sections.after: Read work-plan, reporting and time-limit notices. Ask about exceptions or hardship circumstances and how to document them before a participation problem occurs.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using WFNJ eligibility and application steps, Cash-program categories, Keeping WFNJ assistance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can an adult without children apply?
Yes. WFNJ includes General Assistance for qualifying individuals or couples without children.
Can I apply with an incomplete document set?
The state encourages applying; the worker then identifies missing proof.
What if I need help immediately?
Explain the immediate need at application so the county can assess that request.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
